codeReview.summary: The migration implements most required chat behaviors (SSE stream handling, tool timeline, activity panels, polling cadence, resizer, agent switching, and empty-input guards), but the composer Retry action is functionally broken due to stale-state usage.

issues.description: `retryLastPrompt` sets `draft` and immediately calls `sendMessage()` with no explicit message. `sendMessage` reads `stateRef.current.draft` (line 1597), so when the current draft is empty (normal post-send state), Retry becomes a no-op instead of resubmitting the last prompt.
The e2e suite validates stream retry (`Retry stream`) but does not cover the composer `Retry` button behavior, which allowed the broken retry flow to ship undetected.

sharedStateObservations.observation: `frontend-worker` procedure is partially out of sync with mission reality: it requires full Playwright suite runs and mandatory manual verification, while mission guidance explicitly says full suite failures are known pre-existing during migration and scoped specs are expected.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/skills/frontend-worker/SKILL.md:85 and :87 require full suite + manual verification; mission AGENTS at /home/mojo/.factory/missions/f0f27df9-2ad3-4bff-af4d-b8fe680f5ef3/AGENTS.md:60-62 says full suite is known failing and to use scoped specs. Handoff skillFeedback also marks followedProcedure=false for manual step.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Feature requirement encoding is inconsistent: the feature description includes a composer Retry control, but `expectedBehavior` omits explicit retry verification. This gap likely contributed to missing automated coverage and the shipped retry defect.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: /home/mojo/.factory/missions/f0f27df9-2ad3-4bff-af4d-b8fe680f5ef3/features.json:1211 description includes Send/Retry/Resume/Stop; expectedBehavior list at :1218-1230 does not mention Retry. chat.spec.ts only asserts `Retry stream` (line 339), not composer Retry.
